captions.detailed: A cantilever articulated arm for bench tooling consisting of a dark grey grounded support column with a rectangular mounting base flange. The column holds a horizontal shoulder link, connected to an elbow link, which terminates in a short wrist tool plate. The arm segments are rendered in light grey with dark grey joint connectors, and the entire assembly articulates via three revolute joints about parallel horizontal axes.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cantilever articulated bench arm using CadQuery. The model should feature a dark grey grounded vertical column with a bolted mounting plate, a light grey shoulder link, a matching elbow link, and a dark grey wrist tool plate, all connected in series with revolute joints that allow rotation about parallel horizontal axes.
captions.factory: Construct a base plate using a thin box with holes, and extrude a vertical column from it. Create the shoulder link by combining a box-shaped shoulder joint bracket and an extruded cylindrical arm segment. Build the elbow link with a similar cylindrical segment and matching hinge brackets. Create the wrist tool plate with mounting holes, and define three revolute joints to connect the column, shoulder, elbow, and wrist sequentially.
